archive_policy.reason: The four research-frontier issues should remain writable and discoverable.
gate: The final release and its source archives have been published.
All research-frontier items have been solved, rejected, or migrated to a successor repository.
Open pull requests and issues have been triaged.
The repository has a durable citation and preservation target.

frontiers.title: Prove the integer-cutoff von Mangoldt prime-tail bound
frontiers.summary: Replace the current closed-form majorant interface by an unconditional theorem bounding the omitted prime/von Mangoldt contribution for an integer cutoff.
acceptance_criteria: State the exact sum, normalization, integer cutoff and complete parameter range.
Derive an explicit bound compatible with primeTailMajorant and resolventPrimeTailMajorant.
Use no form of the Riemann hypothesis or an equivalent zero-free assertion.
Add a Lean theorem with no project axioms, sorryAx, sorry or admit.
Add numerical regression checks at boundary and representative parameter values.
non_goals: Using the desired spectral conclusion as an input.

frontiers.title: Prove the slit-plane Stieltjes criterion for Xi zeros
frontiers.summary: Turn the abstract slit-plane extension target into a precise theorem implying that every zero of the critical-line Xi coordinate is real.
acceptance_criteria: Specify the branch, domain, regularity and nonvanishing hypotheses used by the logarithmic derivative.
Handle zero multiplicities and possible singularities explicitly.
Prove XiStieltjesExtensionTarget → XiOnlyRealZeros in Lean.
Document the exact relationship with Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis without asserting an unproved equivalence.
Keep the theorem independent of the proposed concrete spectral model.
non_goals: Treating numerical zero verification as a proof of the criterion.

frontiers.title: Construct and certify the concrete spectral model
frontiers.summary: Define a concrete operator or Galerkin family and prove the structural properties needed by the prime-resolvent comparison without circular use of RH.
acceptance_criteria: Define the Hilbert space, operator domain and finite approximants precisely.
Prove the required self-adjointness, compactness or resolvent properties actually used downstream.
Provide certified links between finite matrices and the infinite operator.
Expose constants and hypotheses through the existing resolvent interface contract.
Include a written no-circularity audit identifying every imported analytic result.
non_goals: Naming a Hilbert–Pólya operator without proving its required properties.
Using observed agreement of eigenvalues as a substitute for convergence.

frontiers.title: Prove the spectral defect rate and operator convergence
frontiers.summary: Establish a concrete defect exponent above one half and combine all error components into the final prime-resolvent convergence theorem.
acceptance_criteria: Prove an explicit q > 1/2 defect rate with quantified constants and ranges.
Verify the hypotheses of rayleighGapDefect or residualGapDefect for the concrete model.
Instantiate PublicationGate.defect and PublicationGate.budget with certified construction data.
Combine spectral, prolate/model and prime-tail errors without hidden asymptotic assumptions.
Prove the concrete PrimeResolventConvergence endpoint in Lean.
Record the resulting rate through rateExponent and verify that no RH-equivalent input was used.
non_goals: Reporting a fitted numerical exponent without a rigorous error enclosure.
Treating a PublicationGate value as evidence for RH unless its defect, budget and Xi extension target have been independently constructed.
